From 642023d04335458a057b549da329ee4e30c8a838 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sean Wang <sean.wang@mediatek.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2020 23:42:21 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] mt76: mt7615: fix up typo in Kconfig for MT7663U

Fix up typo in Kconfig with indicating MT7663U is an 802.11ac device

Fixes: eb99cc95c3b6 ("mt76: mt7615: introduce mt7663u support")
Signed-off-by: Sean Wang <sean.wang@mediatek.com>
Signed-off-by: Felix Fietkau <nbd@nbd.name>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7615/Kconfig b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7615/Kconfig
index e25db1135eda..c094260b0f89 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7615/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7615/Kconfig
@@ -35,6 +35,6 @@ config MT7663U
 	depends on MAC80211
 	depends on USB
 	help
-	  This adds support for MT7663U 802.11ax 2x2:2 wireless devices.
+	  This adds support for MT7663U 802.11ac 2x2:2 wireless devices.
 
 	  To compile this driver as a module, choose M here.
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7615/Kconfig`**
   - The description for the configuration option `MT7663U` was modified. 
   - The original text stated: "This adds support for MT7663U 802.11ax 2x2:2 wireless devices."
   - The updated text corrects the typo to: "This adds support for MT7663U 802.11ac 2x2:2 wireless devices."

### Relationships
- The modification in the `Kconfig` file addresses a typo related to the wireless standard of the MT7663U device. The change clarifies that the device supports 802.11ac instead of the incorrect 802.11ax. This correction is linked to a previous commit (identified by the hash `eb99cc95c3b6`) that introduced support for the MT7663U, ensuring that the documentation accurately reflects the capabilities of the device.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a typo in the Kconfig file that incorrectly identified the MT7663U device as supporting the 802.11ax standard instead of the correct 802.11ac standard. This misrepresentation could lead to confusion regarding the capabilities of the device and potentially impact users trying to configure or utilize the driver.
